meta.title: Codex subagent (bundled CLI)
meta.description: MIT fork of the Codex subagent provider that runs the pinned bundled @openai/codex 0.164.0 binary (codexPath and PATH overrides), with a fixed Serena MCP config, the existing ~/.codex login, model/reasoning-effort targets, read-only and workspace-write providers, and codex_subagent_status
